messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — Acme says live-usage dashboard is a blocker for their pilot. We need a decision: fold into MVP or push to v1?
Joel (Eng): quick gut: full live dashboard = ~3w infra + ~2w frontend + 1w QA. Biggest lift is streaming + retention.
Liam (TPM): adding that would shift current milestone by ~2 sprints. Our latency/cost SLOs could be impacted.
Sarah (Design): we can do a very small MVP surface: KPI row (requests/min, error-rate, cost-est) instead of graphs — cuts frontend to ~4 days.
Anika (Customer Success): Acme prefers graphs but said CSV export + nightly snapshot might be tolerable short-term. They want commitment for live in v1.
DevBot: deploy-bot: canary window ends in 48h for current release.
Maya (PM): proposal: MVP = API + CSV export + KPI row. Live dashboard moved to v1 epic. Offer Acme a dedicated pilot for earlier access (paid). Thoughts?
Joel (Eng): +1. API+CSV avoids streaming infra hit now. If customer pays for Dedicated pilot, we can scope a gated mini-dashboard (throttled, no long retention).
Liam (TPM): plan of record then: 1) Move live-dashboard to v1; 2) Add CSV-export ticket to current sprint; 3) Only shift milestone if Acme signs pilot (then +2 weeks). I'll update roadmap and dependencies.
Sarah (Design): I'll drop two mocks: KPI row (simple) and a compact graph (for v1) by EOD.
Anika (Customer Success): I'll tell Acme today: CSV + KPI row for MVP, live-dashboard prioritized for v1, Dedicated pilot as option. Need an estimated cost uplift for pilot.
Maya (PM): Action items: Joel create CSV ticket; Liam update milestone & doc tradeoffs; Sarah deliver mock; Anika communicate to customer. We'll lock this if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
Joel (Eng): created ticket API-894 for CSV export and assigned to me. ETA: end of sprint.
Liam (TPM): updated GH milestone and added dependency note (infra/batching). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/projects/56 (will paste full link in doc).
Anika (Customer Success): acknowledged, will push Acme for pilot commitment and get back with cost delta.
Maya (PM): cool. closing loop — thanks all.
Joel (Eng): one last note — infra backlog item #442 to revisit continuous batching before v1; flagging here for visibility.
DevBot: ticket created: API-894 (CSV export) assigned to Joel (Eng).
Maya (PM): leaving this thread open for any objections. If none, I'll update the release note and stakeholder email tonight.
